function safeKey(v){return encodeURIComponent(txt(v).replace(/[.#$\[\]\/]/g,'_'))}
function deviceId(){let v='';try{v=txt(localStorage.getItem(DEVICE_KEY))}catch(_){}if(v)return v;try{v=crypto.randomUUID()}catch(_){v='mx-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}try{localStorage.setItem(DEVICE_KEY,v)}catch(_){}return v}

function physicalDeviceKey(){try{const a=Math.min(Number(screen.width||0),Number(screen.height||0)),b=Math.max(Number(screen.width||0),Number(screen.height||0)),aa=Math.min(Number(screen.availWidth||0),Number(screen.availHeight||0)),bb=Math.max(Number(screen.availWidth||0),Number(screen.availHeight||0));let tz='';try{tz=Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone||''}catch(_e){}const raw=[navigator.platform||'',navigator.userAgent||'',navigator.vendor||'',navigator.hardwareConcurrency||'',navigator.deviceMemory||'',a,b,aa,bb,screen.colorDepth||'',screen.pixelDepth||'',window.devicePixelRatio||'',navigator.maxTouchPoints||'',navigator.language||'',(navigator.languages||[]).join(','),tz,mxCanvasDeviceFp()].join('|');return'MXPD-'+mxHashDevice('A|'+raw)+mxHashDevice('B|'+raw)+mxHashDevice('C|'+raw)+mxHashDevice('D|'+raw)}catch(_e){return''}}

function cleanDb(v){v=txt(v).replace(/\/+$/,'');return /^https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+(?:-default-rtdb|-rtdb)?\.(?:firebaseio\.com|firebasedatabase\.app)$/i.test(v)?v:''}
function saveCfg(v){
  /* La Firebase operativa NUNCA se persiste: cada apertura la resuelve desde el Sistema Principal actual. */
  cfg={...cfg,...v};
  try{localStorage.setItem(CFG_KEY,JSON.stringify({branch:norm(cfg.branch),unitName:txt(cfg.unitName),source:txt(cfg.source),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}))}catch(_){}

function loadCfg(){

function hashSync(s){let h=2166136261;for(const c of String(s||'')){h^=c.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return(h>>>0).toString(36)}

function querySystem(){try{return txt(new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('mxSystem')||new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('mxPrincipal')||'').toUpperCase().replace(/[.#$\[\]\/]/g,'_')}catch(_){return''}}
async function fetchJson(url,opt={},ms=7500){const c=new AbortController(),t=setTimeout(()=>c.abort(),ms);try{const r=await fetch(url,{...opt,signal:c.signal,cache:'no-store'});if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return await r.json().catch(()=>null)}finally{clearTimeout(t)}}
function cUrl(p){return CONTROL_DB+(p.startsWith('/')?p:'/'+p)+'.json'}
async function cget(p){try{return await fetchJson(cUrl(p)+'?ts='+Date.now(),{},5500)}catch(_){return null}}

function mxAdminSyncKey(p){const x=String(p||'');if(x.includes('/viewer_licenses/')||x.includes('/viewer_activation_resets/'))return'activations';if(x.includes('/service_orders/'))return'orders';if(x.includes('/inventory_count_')||x.includes('/transfer_'))return'transfers';if(x.includes('/inventory_messages/'))return'messages';if(x.includes('/inventory_'))return'inventory';return''}
async function mxAdminBump(p){const key=mxAdminSyncKey(p);if(!key||String(p||'').includes('/sync_versions/'))return;try{const v=Math.max(Date.now(),Number(localStorage.getItem('mx_admin_sync_'+key)||0)+1);localStorage.setItem('mx_admin_sync_'+key,String(v));await fetchJson(dbUrl(`/sync_versions/${safeKey(branch())}/${key}`),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({v,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),source:'ADMINISTRADOR_ECOSISTEMA'})},5000)}catch(_e){}}

async function patch(p,d){return put(p,d,'PATCH')}
async function del(p){return put(p,null,'PUT')}
function setConn(ok,m){$('#connDot').className='dot '+(ok?'ok':'bad');$('#connText').textContent=m||(ok?'Conectado':'Sin conexión')}
function validSystemId(v){const s=norm(v).replace(/[^A-Z0-9_-]/g,'_');return /^[A-Z0-9_-]{2,100}$/.test(s)?s:''}
async function bind(){
  /* Prioridad 1: el ID enviado por el Sistema Principal que abrió este visor.
     Esto permite usar el mismo código en cualquier cuenta/ruta GitHub sin anclarlo a un cliente. */
  let sid=validSystemId(querySystem()),source=sid?'SYSTEM_ID_URL':'';
  if(!sid){
    /* Fallback dinámico para apertura directa: se identifica la ruta ACTUAL, nunca una URL escrita en código. */
    const [rh,bh]=await Promise.all([sha256(routeSignature()),sha256(baseSignature())]);
    const [rr,br]=await Promise.all([cget('/ecosystem_connection/route_bindings/'+safeKey(rh)),cget('/ecosystem_connection/github_bases/'+safeKey(bh))]);
    const routeOk=rr&&norm(rr.appCode)===APP_CODE?rr:null;
    const routeId=validSystemId(routeOk?.systemId||routeOk?.unitId||routeOk?.branch);
    const baseId=validSystemId(br?.systemId||br?.unitId||br?.branch);
    sid=routeId||baseId;source=routeId?'RUTA_ACTUAL':'BASE_ACTUAL';
  }
  if(!sid)throw new Error('Visor aún no asociado. Ábrelo desde el Sistema Principal o usa Configuración > Verificar visores.');
  const rec=await cget('/ecosystem_connection/'+safeKey(sid));
  if(rec?.connectionEnabled===false)throw new Error('La conexión de este Sistema Principal está deshabilitada');
  const db=cleanDb(rec?.firebaseUrl||rec?.db||rec?.currentUrl||rec?.url);
  if(!db)throw new Error('El Sistema Principal actual no tiene Firebase activa publicada');
  cfg={branch:sid,db,unitName:txt(rec?.unitName||rec?.unidad),source};
  saveCfg(cfg);
  $('#unitText').textContent=cfg.unitName||sid;setConn(true,'Conectado · '+(cfg.unitName||sid));return cfg
}
function branch(){return norm(cfg.branch)}

  function accessButton(){sync();return [...document.querySelectorAll(VALIDATE)].find(b=>!hidden(b)&&!b.disabled)||null}
  function attempt(auto=false){
    if(!pending||busy||navigator.onLine===false||document.visibilityState==='hidden')return;
    const g=gate();if(!g||hidden(g))return;
    const now=Date.now();if(auto&&now-lastAttempt<POLL_MS-300)return;
    const b=accessButton();if(!b)return;
    busy=true;lastAttempt=now;try{b.click()}catch(_e){}finally{setTimeout(()=>{busy=false;sync()},1100)}
  }
  function boot(){
    sync();setTimeout(sync,250);setTimeout(sync,900);
    document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const s=e.target.closest?.(SUBMIT);if(s){setTimeout(sync,250);setTimeout(sync,850);setTimeout(sync,1600)}},true);
    window.addEventListener('mx-viewer-licensed',()=>remember(false));
    window.addEventListener('online',()=>{setTimeout(sync,120);setTimeout(()=>attempt(true),450)});
    window.addEventListener('focus',()=>{setTimeout(sync,100);setTimeout(()=>attempt(true),350)});
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible'){setTimeout(sync,100);setTimeout(()=>attempt(true),350)}});
    const mo=new MutationObserver(()=>sync());mo.observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','hidden']});
    setInterval(()=>{sync();attempt(true)},POLL_MS);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot,{once:true});else boot();
})();
</script>

<!-- MX V169: presentación corta de claves en visores; conserva la clave completa en el DOM y procesos -->
<style id="mx-clave-corta-global-v169">
.mx-clave-vista-v169{font-size:0!important;white-space:nowrap;display:inline!important;pointer-events:none!important}
.mx-clave-vista-v169::after{content:attr(data-mx-clave-corta);font-size:var(--mx-clave-font-size,12px)!important;font-weight:var(--mx-clave-font-weight,inherit)!important;font-family:inherit!important;line-height:inherit!important;letter-spacing:normal!important;color:currentColor!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
</style>
<script id="mx-clave-corta-global-script-v169">
(()=>{
  'use strict';
  const FULL_KEY_RE=/\b\d{3}\.\d{3}\.(\d{4})\.(\d{2})\b/g;
  const SKIP='script,style,noscript,textarea,template,[data-mx-clave-completa]';
  const shortText=(value)=>{FULL_KEY_RE.lastIndex=0;return String(value??'').replace(FULL_KEY_RE,(_,g4,g2)=>g4+'.'+g2);};
  const hasFullKey=(value)=>{FULL_KEY_RE.lastIndex=0;return FULL_KEY_RE.test(String(value??''));};
  window.mxClaveVista=shortText;
  window.mxClaveCorta=shortText;

  function markOption(opt){
    if(!opt)return;
    const raw=opt.textContent||'';
    const visual=shortText(raw);
    if(visual!==raw){
      opt.setAttribute('label',visual);
      opt.dataset.mxClaveCortaV169='1';
      if(!opt.title)opt.title=raw.trim();
    }else if(opt.dataset.mxClaveCortaV169==='1'){
      opt.removeAttribute('label');
      delete opt.dataset.mxClaveCortaV169;
    }
  }

  function makeKeySpan(full,short,parent){
    const span=document.createElement('span');
    span.className='mx-clave-vista-v169';
    span.dataset.mxClaveCorta=short;
    span.dataset.mxClaveCompleta=full;
    span.title=full;
    span.textContent=full;
    try{
      const cs=getComputedStyle(parent);
      span.style.setProperty('--mx-clave-font-size',cs.fontSize||'12px');
      span.style.setProperty('--mx-clave-font-weight',cs.fontWeight||'400');
    }catch(_){
      span.style.setProperty('--mx-clave-font-size','12px');
    }
    return span;
  }

  function processText(node){
    if(!node||node.nodeType!==Node.TEXT_NODE)return;
    const parent=node.parentElement;
    if(!parent||parent.closest(SKIP)||parent.closest('.mx-clave-vista-v169'))return;
    if(parent.namespaceURI&&parent.namespaceURI!=='http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml')return;
    if(parent.tagName==='OPTION'){markOption(parent);return;}
    const raw=node.nodeValue||'';
    if(!hasFullKey(raw))return;
    FULL_KEY_RE.lastIndex=0;
    const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
    let last=0,m;
    while((m=FULL_KEY_RE.exec(raw))){
      if(m.index>last)frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(raw.slice(last,m.index)));
      frag.appendChild(makeKeySpan(m[0],m[1]+'.'+m[2],parent));
      last=m.index+m[0].length;
    }
    if(last<raw.length)frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(raw.slice(last)));
    node.replaceWith(frag);
  }

  function scan(root){
    if(!root)return;
    if(root.nodeType===Node.TEXT_NODE){processText(root);return;}
    if(root.nodeType!==Node.ELEMENT_NODE&&root.nodeType!==Node.DOCUMENT_FRAGMENT_NODE&&root.nodeType!==Node.DOCUMENT_NODE)return;
    if(root.nodeType===Node.ELEMENT_NODE){
      if(root.matches?.(SKIP)||root.closest?.('.mx-clave-vista-v169'))return;
      if(root.tagName==='OPTION'){markOption(root);return;}
    }
    const walker=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,{acceptNode(n){
      const p=n.parentElement;
      if(!p||p.closest(SKIP)||p.closest('.mx-clave-vista-v169'))return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
      return hasFullKey(n.nodeValue||'')?NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT:NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
    }});
    const pending=[];let n;
    while((n=walker.nextNode()))pending.push(n);
    pending.forEach(processText);
    if(root.querySelectorAll)root.querySelectorAll('option').forEach(markOption);
  }

  function start(){
    scan(document.body||document.documentElement);
    const mo=new MutationObserver(list=>{
      for(const rec of list){
        if(rec.type==='characterData'){processText(rec.target);continue;}
        for(const n of rec.addedNodes)scan(n);
      }
    });
    mo.observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true,characterData:true});
    window.__mxClaveCortaObserverV169=mo;
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',start,{once:true});else start();
})();
</script>

</body></html>
